title: Turnfile v0.1 Schema
description: JSON Schema for the SNAP Turnfile coordination state artifact. Validates the structural contract defined in PRD-013 R2. YAML Turnfiles are validated by converting to JSON first (e.g., via js-yaml) then applying this schema.

version.description: Turnfile format version as Semantic Versioning MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (optional -prerelease and +build), matching the release tag so the field and the tag never diverge. Must be a quoted string to avoid YAML implicit typing (PRD-013 R1.1).

workspace.description: Workspace path relative to repo root (e.g., 'working-session/').

agents.description: Agent registry. Each agent writes only their own entry (PRD-013 R2.1).

last_seen.description: Informational session marker for last maintainer activity.

coordination.description: Coordination state. Phase/step are maintainer-only writes; tasks are collaborative (PRD-013 R2.1).

revision.description: Monotonic integer incremented on every successful Turnfile write (PRD-013 R1.3). Used for lease clocks and tie-breaks.

active_phase.description: Current protocol phase. Maintainer-only writes (PRD-013 R4.1).

active_step.description: Current step within the active phase. Maintainer-only writes (PRD-013 R4.1).

conflict.description: Conflict-loop configuration from PRD-021. Defines the default rebuttal bound for Level 2 conflict resolution.

rebuttal_rounds.description: Number of rebuttal rounds per conflict, or 'unbounded' for converge-until-stable mode.

tasks.description: Task registry. Any agent may create; owner may update status; maintainer may reassign (PRD-013 R2.1).

locks.description: Active locks on shared resources. Any agent may acquire/release their own locks (PRD-013 R2.1, R3.3).

turn_queue.description: Ordered list of pending turn claims. Agents append; maintainer may reorder (PRD-013 R2.1).

messages.description: Lightweight signal channel. Append-only during sessions; compacted at session close (PRD-013 R5.3, R6.4).

current_task.description: Task ID the agent is currently working on, or null.

last_seen.description: Informational session marker (e.g., 'codex-session-12'). Non-authoritative for coordination (PRD-013 R1.3).

session_id.description: Current session identifier, or null if not in a session.

instances.description: Optional same-family instance registry for PRD-049. Omitted for normal single-instance operation.

agent_instance_entry.description: Per-instance registration entry within a provider family.

session_id.description: Current instance session identifier, or null if not in a session.

current_task.description: Task ID the instance is currently working on, or null.

lane_role.description: Family lane role for same-family multi-instance collaboration.

task_entry.description: Task registry entry. Lifecycle: pending -> claimed -> in_progress -> done (or blocked). See PRD-013 R6.1-R6.3.

depends_on.description: List of task IDs that must be done before this task can be claimed (PRD-013 R6.2).

created_rev.description: Coordination revision when the task was created.

claim_rev.description: Coordination revision when the task was claimed, or null if unclaimed.

completed_rev.description: Coordination revision when the task was completed, or null if not yet done.

lock_entry.description: Lock on shared resources. Stale when (coordination.revision - acquired_rev) > lease_revs (PRD-013 R3.3).

files.description: List of file paths under lock.

acquired_rev.description: Coordination revision when lock was acquired.

lease_revs.description: Number of revisions before the lock is considered stale. Default: 2.

action.description: Brief description of the intended action.

requested_rev.description: Coordination revision when the turn was requested.

signal_entry.description: Lightweight coordination signal. Not a replacement for MAILBOX.md (PRD-013 R6.4).

rev.description: Coordination revision when the signal was posted.

detail.description: Optional brief context for the signal.
